question: How does the structural representation of the complex glycan 'α-D-Manp-(1→3)[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→O)Cer' change when converted from IUPAC Extended format to WURCS format, using the GlyTouCan database?
final_answer: Converting the IUPAC Extended string α-D-Manp-(1→3)[α-D-Manp-(1→6)]-β-D-Manp-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-GlcpNAc-(1→4)-β-D-Glcp-(1→O)Cer with the GlycanFormatConverter yields WURCS=2.0/4,6,5/[a2122h-1b_1-5][a2122h-1b_1-5_2*NCC/3=O][a1122h-1b_1-5][a1122h-1a_1-5]/1-2-2-3-4-4/a4-b1_b4-c1_c4-d1_d3-e1_d6-f1. In this WURCS representation, the linear/branched IUPAC notation is rewritten as a residue-code block (4 distinct residue types — two HexNAc [a2122h-1b_1-5_2*NCC/3=O], two Hex [a1122h-1b_1-5], and α-Man [a1122h-1a_1-5]) followed by the residue sequence (6 residues: 1-2-2-3-4-4) and the linkage map (a4-b1_b4-c1_c4-d1_d3-e1_d6-f1), which explicitly encodes the Man(1→3) and Man(1→6) branches on the β-Man, its (1→4) link to the chitobiose core, and the reducing-end (1→O) attachment. Notably, the ceramide aglycone ('Cer') is not encoded in the WURCS glycan portion; only the six-sugar oligosaccharide is represented. Querying GlyTouCan with this WURCS returned 'Accession not found,' i.e., this exact structure (with the ceramide-derived reducing-end context) has no registered GlyTouCan accession, so the identifier lookup step could not supply a GlyTouCan ID.
